gloss: to readjust; to rearrange; to put back in order

definitions.gloss: to readjust; to rearrange; to put back in order
definitions.explanation: to adjust or arrange something again that has become disorganized or needs correction

examples.japanese: {髪|かみ}を{整|ととの}え{直|なお}す。
{計画|けいかく}を{整|ととの}え{直|なお}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: We need to readjust the plan.

examples.japanese: {呼吸|こきゅう}を{整|ととの}え{直|なお}して{再|さい}スタートした。
examples.english: I caught my breath again and restarted.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

COMPOUND VERB:
{整|ととの}える (to arrange/prepare) + {直|なお}す (to redo/fix)
The {直|なお}す adds the nuance of doing again or correcting.

COMMON OBJECTS:
- {身|み}だしなみを{整|ととの}え{直|なお}す (to tidy up one's appearance)
- {体制|たいせい}を{整|ととの}え{直|なお}す (to reorganize the system)
- {態勢|たいせい}を{整|ととの}え{直|なお}す (to regroup, get ready again)

SIMILAR COMPOUND VERBS:
- やり{直|なお}す (to redo)
- {立|た}て{直|なお}す (to rebuild, to recover)
- {組|く}み{直|なお}す (to reorganize)

RELATED WORDS:
- {整|ととの}える (to arrange, to prepare)
- {調整|ちょうせい}する (to adjust)
- {再編成|さいへんせい}する (to reorganize)
